descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The Hole Never Ends
💀 A VR descent into darkness.
Deep beneath the Karst Rift Zone, expeditions vanish without a trace. Whispers echo through the caverns, strange shapes move in the dark—and now it’s your turn to enter.
🪓 Features

 True immersion: Crawl, climb, and squeeze through suffocating tunnels with only your headlamp to guide you.
[media]


 Treasure vs. terror: Mine rare minerals and relics, trade with hidden merchants, and upgrade your gear—knowing every discovery draws the darkness closer.
[media]
[media]

 Unpredictable fear: Collapsing tunnels, shifting paths, and creatures that stalk your every move. Even the cave itself feels alive.
[media]
[media]
 Endgame: Find the corruption source, face its guardian, and destroy it… if you make it that far.
[media]

⚠️ WARNING
 Not a casual VR adventure. Expect screams, racing heartbeats, and fear that lingers after the headset comes off.
👉 Enter Horror Cave. Escape with treasure—if you can.
